notes: Bill is a 2-section amendment (enacted Public Law 119-77) editing Section 205(r) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 405(r)). Full source read (enrolled/public-law text, 3521 chars). No referencedSources registered on the bill. All substantive bill-content claims (summary, brief, top_lines, sections, underreported, gaps, changes) are SUPPORTED with verbatim spans. Zero material issues. 4 minor: (1) 'subject to periodic review' vs source's discretionary 'may periodically review'; (2) '(C)' called a 'new paragraph' when it is a new subparagraph; (3) sponsor/cosponsor and (4) vote-method details in likelihoodReason are structural metadata not present in the bill text (rubric class 8 permits structural facts). 1 minor omission: the 205(r)(3)(A)/(B) proviso conditioning the data sharing. featured_quotes (CR floor speeches) were NOT audited — the Congressional Record source is not in the provided bill-text file and no CR referencedSource is registered, so they are unverifiable against available source.
